title: Notebook
brief: Rebuild to the standard. What it is: Gives Claude a note tool for writing down what its future self should know about this project, and reads the notes back next session. Known faults of the earlier version: it acts or writes while switched off; it has one long test that never checks the off state, restore from the store, the placements or a narrow card. Keep the idea, design it afresh, and drop what does not earn its place.

stamps.reason: The spec meets the standard, every hook and call it names is in the types file, all card states and the 20-column card are drawn, both faults of the brief are addressed, and it is within size (112 lines, 15 acceptance lines); 11 notes.
Built notebook-widget to the spec: the jot tool, per-project notes read back on the first prompt and after a compaction, the card at three widths, and 15 acceptance tests; the checker passes.

Meets the spec, the standard and the bar: checker passes, cards read at 20, 40 and 60 columns, off is inert, the live run stored only what the spec names; six non-blocking findings, the first being that the read-back still wants a live rerun.
On the demo page, in the README and the marketplace; smoke test clean
